scripts.dev: node -e "if(!require('fs').existsSync('dist/index.html')){ require('child_process').execSync('npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); }" && node server.ts
scripts.build: (npm --prefix client run build || npx vite build client || true) && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')){ fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); }"
